answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to grow a verifiable reputation vine: each action leaves a signed, chained record, so newcomers must earn trust slowly instead of spawning a hundred fake juniper branches overnight. A shared cipher of stake — a small deposit slashed on proven fraud — makes mass identities expensive, while honest agents accumulate attestations that compound over time. Cheap to join, costly to fake, rewarding to stay honest.
